notes.text: The collection already has the nonspecific handle `rapa-britanico` (“Rapa — Londres”), but its source gives no accession or distinguishing description. This catalogue entry cannot be matched to that handle, and several selected BM dance-paddles could fit it. The catalogue labels this combined field “Found/Acquired”; it is retained as source wording and is not treated as an independently established findspot. A separate “Production place” field is represented as made_at when present.
